vc_town_hall_desc: Founds your colony and brings its first citizens. Shift+E manages the colony.
vc_hut_lumberjack_desc: Employs a lumberjack who cuts and replants trees around it. Build near a Chieftain's Camp.
vc_hall_gone_grace: The Chieftain's Camp is gone: raise a new one here within {0} days to keep the colony
vc_hall_gone_grace_one: The Chieftain's Camp is gone: raise a new one here within a day to keep the colony
vc_no_jobless: No jobless settlers. A newcomer comes when there's a free bed, food in the camp's chest and the colony isn't unhappy.
vc_has_worker: This hut already has a worker.
vc_hire_pending: Someone is on their way. Give it a moment.
vc_worker_far: The worker is too far away to be fired right now.
vc_fired_autohire_off: Worker fired. Auto-hire is now off so the hut doesn't hire them straight back.
vc_town_hall_not_loaded: The Chieftain's Camp isn't loaded. Come closer to the colony.
vc_takedown_own_falls_one: Your {0} rests on the building and will fall when it comes down: move it first to keep it. Click again to take it down.
vc_takedown_own_falls: Your {0} and {1} more rest on the building and will fall when it comes down: move them first to keep them. Click again to take it down.
vc_takedown_ordered: A builder will take it down; its chest's contents go to the camp
vc_takedown_store_full: Empty the chests inside first (with a courier hired, couriers carry all but gear away): {0}
vc_takedown_store_not_empty: Not taken down: the chests inside aren't empty yet.
vc_takedown_emptying: Its couriers carry the store's goods to the colony's other chests first; then a builder takes it down.
vc_store_emptying: Emptying the store for its take-down: {0} left
vc_store_emptying_gear: Couriers don't carry gear and tools: take {0} out, and the take-down goes on.
vc_store_emptying_no_courier: Emptying the store for its take-down, but no courier is hired: hire one, or take {0} out yourself.
vc_store_emptied: The store is empty: a builder takes it down next.
vc_creative_refused: Creative mode isn't on for you here (No build cost in the world, or debug mode as an admin).
vc_creative_admin_unknown: Another player's game runs this building and can't tell that you're an admin. Try again when they're away from it (then your game or the server runs it), or turn on No build cost for the world.
vc_creative_supply_free: The builders build for free in this world (No build cost): there's nothing to supply.
vc_creative_point: Point at a button to see what it does.
vc_tip_alarm: Everyone shelters indoors as in a raid, and the guards gather where you stand, for 5 minutes or until you press All clear.
vc_tip_handover: Puts what the builders still need, beyond what the colony's chests already hold, from your bag into the camp's chest.
vc_tip_handover_hut: Puts what the builder's order still needs, beyond what the colony's chests hold, from your bag into this hut's chest.
vc_tip_recall_settler: Brings them at once to a free spot by the camp, wherever they are.
vc_tip_send_away: They leave the colony for good, and what they carry goes into the camp's chest. It asks you once more first.
vc_tip_do_first: Builders take this order before everything else, even their own hut, and resume it if it was set aside.
vc_tip_set_aside: No builder takes this order until you press Resume.
vc_tip_hire: Gives this hut a jobless settler as its worker.
vc_tip_fire: The worker leaves the job. Auto-hire turns off, so they aren't hired back at once.
vc_tip_autohire: On: a hut without a worker hires a jobless settler by itself.
vc_tip_recall_hut: Calls the worker back to the hut at once.
vc_tip_take_rest: On: couriers may take what this hut doesn't keep, to the storehouse or to whoever is short of it.
vc_tip_wood_limit: The lumberjack rests once the colony's chests hold this much Wood. Click for no limit, 200, 500 or 1000.
vc_tip_post: The guards go back to the tower's door. The guard post stays, with no tower, until you press Next tower on it.
vc_tip_orders: Patrol: rounds of the colony's buildings. Hold post: they stay at their post. Click to switch.
vc_tip_role: Warrior: the best melee weapon and a shield. Archer: the best bow or crossbow with its ammunition. Click to switch.
vc_tip_takedown: A builder takes the building down; its chest's contents go to the camp. It asks you once more first.
vc_tip_stock_step: Changes how many it keeps by 5; with Shift held, by a whole stack.
vc_tip_field_leave: This field stops being worked by its Farm.
vc_tip_feast_lay: The cook makes it and its dishes from spare food, the Kitchen list's too, and lays it out. Each settler takes one; the last 2 are yours.
vc_tip_feast_cancel: Takes back the feast you asked for while the cook hasn't made it yet. A feast already laid stays.
vc_creative_build_hover: Finishes what the builder is building here at once: every piece up, no materials.
vc_creative_upgrade_hover: One level up at once, as high as the camp's level allows (no Builder's Hut needed).
vc_creative_repair_hover: Every broken or missing piece back at once.
vc_creative_supply_hover: Puts what the colony's orders still need into this hut's chest, for its builders to fetch: watch them build without gathering.
vc_creative_finish_all_hover: Finishes every open order of the colony at once, two a second (not a hut being taken down).
vc_creative_level_hover: Sets the camp's level without the trophies: the colony's area, its settlers and the huts' limit follow. Lowering takes nothing built away.
vc_creative_add_hover: Newcomers join at once, up to what the colony's level allows; they need no bed or food to come.
vc_creative_eat_hover: This colony's settlers need no meals while the world has No build cost; they eat again when it hasn't.

vc_creative_place_builder: Creative: the builder builds it ([{1}] to put it up at once)

vc_key_creative_down: Creative: one level lower when placed

vc_saga_bossfell: Day {0}: {1} has fallen, and the colony drank to it.

vc_handover_no_order: No work order to hand over for
vc_handover_busy: The chest is busy; try again
vc_trees_hint: Fell: the lumberjack cuts this kind down. Replant: where a tree comes down, the ticked kinds' saplings are planted in turn (with a Cultivator in the colony's chests).
vc_pick_hint: The forager picks the ticked kinds that grow wild near the hut, and only what grows back. Food feeds the colony; the rest waits in the hut's chest for you.
vc_perks_lumberjack: works {0} m around the hut, axes up to {1}, {2} chest rows
vc_perks_builder: axes up to {0}, pickaxes up to {1}, {2} chest rows
vc_replant_needs_cultivator: Replanting: needs a Cultivator in the colony's chests
vc_hut_builder_desc: Employs a builder who puts up your huts' buildings piece by piece. Build near a Chieftain's Camp.
vc_hut_longhouse_desc: Beds for your settlers: each bed is a home, and they sleep there at night. The builder puts up its building. Build near a Chieftain's Camp.
vc_hut_forager_desc: Hires a forager, who picks wild berries and mushrooms around the hut and brings them home: food for the colony. Build near a Chieftain's Camp.
vc_hut_farm_desc: Hires a farmer, who works the fields you mark with Field markers (one per level) and grows crops from the seeds in its chest. Put a Cultivator and seeds in it. Build near a Chieftain's Camp.
vc_hut_storehouse_desc: The colony's store: every chest inside it holds the colony's goods. One per colony; a Builder's Hut builds it. Build within a colony's area.
vc_hut_watchtower_desc: Hires a guard, who keeps monsters off the colony with the best weapon and shield in its chest, and pushes the colony's border out: huts may be built by it. Build within a colony's area.
vc_hut_meadhall_desc: The colony's kitchen and table: its cook roasts the colony's spare raw meat and fish on the cooking stations inside it, and nothing burns; settlers eat a hot breakfast here. Its Kitchen tab keeps the dishes you choose ready in its chest. One per colony. Build within a colony's area.

vc_step_builder_hut_line: Your colony needs a builder. Place a Builder's Hut nearby with the hammer, and put an axe, a pickaxe and a hoe in its chest: its builder puts up every other building.
vc_step_worker_line: Place a hut for a trade (a Lumberjack's Hut, a Farm, a Forager's Hut). Once it stands, a settler without a job takes it.
vc_step_longhouse_line: Settlers need homes. A Longhouse gives them beds, and a free bed brings a newcomer.
vc_step_food_line: Put food in the camp's chest. Settlers eat from the colony's chests, and a newcomer comes only when there's food.
vc_step_watchtower_line: Raise a Watchtower and arm it from its chest: a guard keeps watch over the colony.
vc_step_camp_level_2_line: Show the Forsaken's trophies at the camp to raise its level: a bigger colony, more settlers and the next age of huts.
vc_step_done_line: The colony stands on its own now. Hugin will still say when something is new.

vc_tip_colony: This Chieftain's Camp founds your colony, and settlers have come to live here. Give them work: build a Builder's Hut first (from the hammer's Misc tab) and put a flint axe, an antler pickaxe and a hoe in its chest. The builder puts up every other hut. Press Shift+E on the camp to see your colony.
vc_tip_meadhall: A Mead Hall's cook roasts the colony's spare raw meat and fish so nothing burns, and settlers eat a hot breakfast here. Hire a cook in its window, and put a cooking station over a fire inside it (its design brings one).
vc_tip_storehouse: A Storehouse keeps the colony's goods in the chests standing inside it, yours too. Once it stands, hire a courier in its window: couriers fill what every building keeps in stock, take the huts' surplus to the storehouse, and put away what you drop in its own chest (the one with its sign). Its Needs tab says what each building is short of and what to bring.
vc_tip_builder: A hut stands empty until a builder puts it up, and this colony has no Builder's Hut yet. Build one near your Chieftain's Camp first.
vc_tip_needs: Your builder fetches materials from the colony's chests: put what the builder needs in any hut's chest or in the camp's. The tools stay in the chests too. The camp's Work tab lists everything still to bring.
vc_tip_worker: A finished hut hires a settler. Press Shift+E on a hut to see its worker, its level and what an upgrade needs.
vc_tip_night: At night your settlers go indoors to sleep. Build Longhouses so everyone has a bed: a free bed and food in the camp's chest bring newcomers to the colony.
vc_tip_hunger: A hungry settler works slower. Settlers eat once a day from the colony's chests; a Forager's Hut brings home wild food.
vc_tip_death: A settler died. Anything they carried lies in a cairn where they fell. The camp's Saga remembers them.

vc_tip_freetime: Your settlers have nothing to do just now. Give them a bench or a fire near the camp and their huts, and they'll sit, warm themselves and talk.
vc_tip_stock: A building's Keep in stock list is what its chest keeps: other settlers leave those items there, and settlers with free time carry what's missing from chests that can spare it. The camp keeps 10 food for newcomers until you change its list.
vc_tip_field: A Farm's farmer works fields. Put a Field marker from the hammer's Misc tab near the Farm or in its yard, press E on it to choose a crop and a size, and keep seeds and a Cultivator in the Farm's chest.
vc_tip_evening: In the evening your settlers stop work and gather at the camp before they go to bed. Light a campfire or a hearth near it and they'll sit round the fire instead.
vc_talk_evening_1: Good to sit down after a long day.
vc_status_evening_hall: Evening at the camp (no fire is lit outdoors)
vc_talk_evening_2: My back aches. A good day, then.
vc_talk_evening_3: Tell the one about the troll and the goat again!
vc_talk_evening_5: Pass the mead. No, the other one.
vc_talk_evening_6: A warm fire and the stars out. That's enough for me.
vc_talk_mourn_1: I keep looking for {0} at the woodpile.
vc_talk_mourn_5: I'll carve {0}'s name on a stone.
vc_talk_mourn_6: {0} always knew where the best berries grew.
vc_talk_hungry_1: My belly's growling louder than a troll.
vc_talk_hungry_2: Is there nothing to eat in this colony?
vc_talk_hungry_3: I'd trade my axe for a bowl of stew.
vc_talk_hungry_6: Someone fill the camp's chest, please.
vc_talk_weather_1: Wet wood, wet boots, wet beard.
vc_talk_weather_2: Thor is in a mood today.
vc_talk_weather_3: My boots are full of water.
vc_talk_weather_4: Good weather for staying under a roof.
vc_talk_weather_5: Even the trolls stay home in this.
vc_talk_weather_6: Soaked again. The fields will be glad, at least.
vc_talk_newhere_2: Where do I sleep around here?
vc_talk_newhere_3: I walked three days to get here. Worth it.
vc_talk_newhere_5: Which of these huts is mine?
vc_talk_newhere_6: They told me there'd be mead.
vc_talk_newcomer_2: {0} turned up today. Another mouth to feed.
vc_talk_newcomer_3: I hope {0} can swing an axe.
vc_talk_newcomer_4: {0} says it was a long walk here.
vc_talk_built_2: Did you see the {0}? Up in a day, nearly.
vc_talk_built_3: Another {0}. This is becoming a proper town.
vc_talk_built_4: I helped carry the timber for that {0}. Well, I watched.
vc_talk_built_5: The {0} still smells of fresh-cut timber.
vc_talk_built_6: Someone should carve runes on that {0}.
vc_talk_wait_no_trees_1: Not a tree left standing. Give it time.
vc_talk_wait_no_trees_2: The saplings are growing. Slowly. Very slowly.
vc_talk_wait_crops_growing_2: Nothing to do but watch carrots grow.
vc_talk_wait_crops_growing_3: The field needs time, and so do I.
vc_talk_wait_crops_growing_4: A farmer's work is mostly waiting.
vc_talk_wait_nothing_to_pick_1: The bushes need a rest. So do I.
vc_talk_wait_nothing_to_pick_3: Not a berry left out there.
vc_talk_wait_nothing_to_pick_4: I know every bush by name now.
vc_talk_wait_no_work_1: Nothing to build. My hammer misses me.
vc_talk_wait_no_work_2: Give me a hut to raise and I'm happy.
vc_talk_wait_no_work_4: Measure twice, cut once. When there's something to cut.
vc_talk_jobless_1: If anyone needs a strong back, I'm here.
vc_talk_jobless_2: I could work, if someone built me a hut.
vc_talk_jobless_3: Idle hands, they say. Mine are very idle.
vc_talk_jobless_4: I'd make a fine forager, I think.
vc_talk_jobless_5: I'm good with my hands. Ask anyone.
vc_talk_jobless_6: A hut to work in. That's all I ask.
vc_talk_general_1: Did you hear the trolls last night?
vc_talk_general_2: My grandfather fought a troll with a spoon. So he said.
vc_talk_general_3: Odin sees all. Even what you had for breakfast.
vc_talk_general_4: A good fire, good mead, good friends. What else is there?
vc_talk_general_5: Who ate the last of the honey?
vc_talk_general_7: I dreamt of the sea again.
vc_talk_general_8: One day I'll sail to the Plains. One day.
vc_talk_general_11: This is a good place to grow old.
vc_talk_general_13: Keep your axe sharp and your fire lit.
vc_talk_general_14: I saw a deer this big. Bigger.
vc_talk_general_15: My grandmother could out-drink a dwarf.
vc_talk_general_16: Some say there's a whole other land past the mist.
vc_talk_trade_lumberjack_1: Birch splits easy. Oak fights back.
vc_talk_trade_lumberjack_2: Timber! Ha, I always wanted to shout that.
vc_talk_trade_lumberjack_3: Fell one, plant one. That's the way.
vc_talk_trade_lumberjack_4: Mind your head when they come down.
vc_talk_trade_builder_1: A straight beam and a level floor. Beautiful.
vc_talk_trade_builder_2: What I raise stands for a hundred winters.
vc_talk_trade_builder_3: Stone below, wood above, thatch to keep it dry.
vc_talk_trade_builder_4: Hand me that hammer, would you?
vc_talk_trade_farmer_2: Good soil here. Dark and rich.
vc_talk_trade_farmer_3: Keep the boars out of my rows!
vc_talk_trade_farmer_4: A full field is a full belly.
vc_talk_trade_forager_1: The best raspberries hide by the rocks.
vc_talk_trade_forager_2: Mushrooms under the old pines. Don't tell.
vc_talk_trade_forager_3: I know where the blueberries are. I'm not saying.
vc_talk_trade_forager_4: A basket of dandelions and a song. A good day.
vc_talk_trade_guard_3: Greydwarfs again. I can smell them.
vc_talk_repelled_1: We held them off! Did you see?
vc_talk_repelled_3: Let them try again. We're ready.
vc_talk_repelled_4: My knees still shake from that raid.
vc_talk_boss_1: {0} is gone, they say. The world feels lighter.
vc_talk_boss_2: {0}, fallen! There'll be songs about that.
vc_talk_boss_3: {0} is gone. Maybe we'll sleep easier now.
vc_talk_boss_4: {0}, slain! Whoever did it drinks free at my fire.
vc_talk_pastime_archery_3: Closer than last time. That counts.
vc_talk_pastime_archery_4: One day I'll hit the middle on purpose.
vc_talk_pastime_weaponpractice_1: Take that, you sack of straw!
vc_talk_pastime_weaponpractice_2: The dummy never hits back. My kind of fight.
vc_talk_pastime_weaponpractice_3: Left, right, duck. Left, right, duck.
vc_talk_pastime_weaponpractice_5: My arms will feel this tomorrow.
vc_talk_pastime_boardgame_4: You moved that piece when I blinked, {0}!
vc_talk_pastime_boardgame_5: Three more moves and you're done for.
vc_talk_pastime_toast_2: To the colony, and full mugs!
vc_talk_pastime_toast_3: To {0}, who still owes me a mead.
vc_talk_pastime_toast_4: To the ones who built this place!
vc_talk_pastime_toast_5: Drink up before it gets warm.
vc_talk_pastime_poledance_3: My feet remember this from home.
vc_talk_pastime_story_1: ...and then the troll sat down on the goat!
vc_talk_pastime_story_2: It was a dark and stormy night...
vc_talk_pastime_story_3: So there I was, knee-deep in the swamp...
vc_talk_pastime_story_4: And that, my friends, is how I lost my boot.
vc_talk_pastime_story_5: No skald could tell it better.
vc_talk_pastime_listening_2: That's not how it went last time, {0}.
vc_talk_pastime_admire_1: Look at the size of that.
vc_talk_pastime_admire_2: I'd not want to meet that one in the woods.
vc_talk_pastime_admire_3: A fine trophy. Who brought it home?
vc_talk_pastime_admire_4: One day mine will hang there too.
vc_talk_pastime_map_1: So much we haven't seen yet.
vc_talk_pastime_map_2: We are here. And over there, trolls.
vc_talk_pastime_map_3: Who drew this coastline? A goat?
vc_talk_pastime_map_4: One day I'll sail to that edge.
vc_talk_pastime_firedance_1: Dance, before the fire dies down!
vc_talk_pastime_firedance_3: Who taught you to dance? A troll?
vc_talk_pastime_pettame_3: You'd guard us well, wouldn't you?

vc_builder_left_level_msg: {0} leaves the {1} for now: it waits for a builder from a higher Builder's Hut.

vc_upgrading: Upgrading to level {0}: {1} of {2} pieces, {3} old ones to take away
vc_upgrading_own: Upgrading to level {0}: {1} of {2} pieces, {3} old ones to take away, {4} of yours to put back

vc_site_ready: Ready: the builder can start building right away

vc_site_no_level_many: {0}: no Builder's Hut level can clear them, so clear them yourself

vc_site_red_one_meadhall: The colony already has a Mead Hall

vc_site_own_bed: Your {0} is a bed someone sleeps in: move it first

vc_mood_settling_page: Settling in: their mood shows within a minute or so.
vc_newcomer_unhappy: nobody wants to join an unhappy colony
vc_no_settler_body: Settlers can't come: the settler body didn't load (see the game's log).
vc_saga_repelled: Day {0}: a raid on the colony was held off, and nobody was lost.
vc_saga_repelled_by: Day {0}: {1} held a raid on the colony off, and nobody was lost.
vc_tip_mood: One of your settlers is unhappy. Settlers like a home with a cosy bed, a meal a day (better yet, varied food), an evening by the fire and work in their own trade. Unhappy settlers work slower, and nobody joins an unhappy colony. Hover over a settler to see how they feel, and choose them in the camp's window to see why.
vc_talk_cheerful_1: What a day to be alive!
vc_talk_cheerful_2: I've a good feeling about this place.
vc_talk_cheerful_3: Ha! The gods smile on us.
vc_talk_cheerful_5: Sun on my face and wood in the chest. Perfect.
vc_talk_grumpy_1: Hmph. Too much work, too little mead.
vc_talk_grumpy_2: My back aches. My back always aches.
vc_talk_grumpy_6: Too many people, too few chairs.
vc_hut_miner_desc: The colony's mine: its miner digs stone at the face in its yard, and ore as the hut grows. One per colony. Build within a colony's area.
vc_camp_takedown_sure: Sure? Its {0} settlers stay. Raise a new camp among these huts within {1} days to keep the colony, or found one anywhere and they set out for it. Remove it again to take it down.
vc_camp_takedown_sure_one_day: Sure? Its {0} settlers stay. Raise a new camp among these huts within a day to keep the colony, or found one anywhere and they set out for it. Remove it again to take it down.
vc_camp_takedown_sure_no_grace: Sure? Its {0} settlers stay without a colony until you found a new camp, then they set out for it. Remove it again to take it down.
vc_camp_takedown_sure_nobody: Sure? Remove the camp again to take it down.
vc_camp_takedown_sure_one: Sure? Its one settler stays. Raise a new camp among these huts within {1} days to keep the colony, or found one anywhere and they set out for it. Remove it again to take it down.
vc_camp_takedown_sure_one_one_day: Sure? Its one settler stays. Raise a new camp among these huts within a day to keep the colony, or found one anywhere and they set out for it. Remove it again to take it down.
vc_camp_takedown_sure_one_no_grace: Sure? Its one settler stays without a colony until you found a new camp, then they set out for it. Remove it again to take it down.
vc_hall_can_go_up: Can go up a level now: {0}
vc_site_red_one_miner: The colony already has a Miner's Hut
vc_idle_storage_full: Storage full: empty the hut's chest
vc_idle_jobless: No job: give them one in a hut's window
vc_idle_unemployed: Their hut is gone: give them a job in a hut's window
vc_yours_ravens_off: raven hints off in the game
vc_tip_yours_hugin: Hugin, the raven, explains the colony as you play, each tip once. It needs the game's raven hints on.
vc_tip_yours_words: A settler near you who needs something says so above their head.
vc_tip_yours_talk: Settlers greet you and chat above their heads in their free time.
vc_tip_yours_death: How you're told a settler died: in the middle of the screen and in chat, or in chat only.
vc_tip_yours_size: How big VikingColonies' windows are on your screen, from 75% to 150%.
vc_tip_yours_language: The language of VikingColonies' words. Same as the game means Valheim's own; a file of your own adds its language here.
vc_tip_gpost_next: Gives this post to the next Watchtower whose circle reaches it and that has no post yet.
vc_post_line_tower: Post: by the tower. Build a Guard post from the hammer where they should stand, inside the tower's circle.
vc_post_line_chosen: Post: where you chose, {0} m {1} of the tower
vc_overview_over_limit: Over the limit: no newcomers until there's room
vc_guard_post_piece_desc: A spear and shield where a Watchtower's guards stand. Build it inside a tower's circle: the nearest tower without a post takes it.
vc_gpost_tower_empty: A Watchtower with no guards yet
vc_gpost_place_outside: A guard post goes in your colony, inside a Watchtower's circle
vc_gpost_by_hand: No tower: it was taken from its tower. Next tower gives it to one.
vc_gpost_taken: Each tower within reach has a post already
vc_gpost_orders_rounds: Its guards walk rounds and come back here between them.
vc_gpost_how: A Watchtower takes a post inside its circle: {0} m at level 1, more as it goes up.
vc_gpost_no_other: No other tower without a post reaches here
vc_gpost_moved_meanwhile: That post was given to another tower meanwhile
vc_tip_showme: Closes this window and pins your own map for a minute where they are, or were last seen. Only you see it.
vc_tip_idle: A settler can't work until you help. The camp's Overview says how many; a click there lists each one's reason, and Show me finds them.
vc_pad_hint: D-pad: move · A: press · LB / RB: tabs · B: close
vc_pad_hint_notabs: D-pad: move · A: press · B: close

vc_grow_costs_more: not planted: it takes more than its seed

vc_store_holding_unseen: {0} couriers can't put away what they carry: is the storehouse full, or the way to its chests blocked?
